headline: Contested Sectors Keep the Front Ledger Moving
war_summary: The latest returns show movement concentrated on three active sectors, with several formerly busy fronts now quiet. Farranac Coast logged eight base events in the latest six hours and 15 across the day; its ledger remains divided, seven Colonial-held bases to four Warden-held. Deadlands recorded three events in the last two hours and seven over 24 hours, including losses, neutralization, and captures, while ownership stands four Warden to seven Colonial. Godcrofts likewise produced five events in the latest two hours and 15 across the day, despite an eight-to-one Warden majority; enlistments have accelerated in the short comparison. Lykos Isle remains strategically divided five Colonial to two Warden, but its 22 daily events are older, with no movement recorded in the latest six hours. Tempest Island shows 13 events over 24 hours, though none in the latest two hours, and all nine bases are Colonial-held. Fisherman’s Row also saw 11 daily events, but its most recent six-hour ledger has gone still after earlier contests, leaving eight Warden bases against one Colonial.
